100 Bullets.name: 100 Bullets
100 Bullets.summary: Part hard-boiled crime story, part paranoid espionage thriller, 100 Bullets follows what happens when people from all walks of life meet Agent Graves, a mysterious figure who offers his "clients" the opportunity of a lifetime: an attache case containing the proof, the gun, and the carte blanche immunity to exact revenge on a person who's done them an irrevocable wrong. Based on the Brian Azzarello's Veritgo comic of the same name, 100 Bullets features an original story by Azzarelo himself, two playable characters, and fully interactive environments. This version of 100 Bullets was cancelled when Acclaim closed up shop, but a new game based on 100 Bullets was created for a 2007 release.

Bakushou!! Jinsei Kaidou - Nova Usagi ga.name: Bakushou!! Jinsei Kaidoh: Nova Usagi ga Miteru zo!!
Bakushou!! Jinsei Kaidou - Nova Usagi ga.summary: Bakusho!! Jinsei Kaido NOVA Usagi ga Miteruzo!! is a Japanese party game for up to four players, licensed by NOVA and the Tong King Show.

Classic British Motor Racing.name: Classic British Motor Racing
Classic British Motor Racing.summary: Classic British Motor Racing is a racing simulation game. Choose from an amazing range of 13 high performance classic cars, including Austin Mini, Austin-Healy, MG, Rover and Triumph. Each car is accurately recreated under license and features the real handling characteristics of the vehicles. Race through six different courses throughout the British Isles, including the heart-stopping thrills of the traditional 'Westminster Run' around the streets of London. Take on various game modes, including Time Trial and Grand Prix. Try and beat the track records or race against friends in the insanely addictive multiplayer mode.

Cool Boarders 2001.name: Cool Boarders 2001
Cool Boarders 2001.summary:
Cool Boarders 2001 features new board parks, champion snowboarders, and 20 diverse courses with various events like downhill and trick completion. Compete in the Vans Triple Crown of Snowboarding to unlock tracks and boards.

Cool Boarders 2001 is the only Cool Boarders title to be released exclusively in North America.

Guitar Hero - Greatest Hits.name: Guitar Hero: Smash Hits
Guitar Hero - Greatest Hits.summary:
Guitar Hero Smash Hits is the best of Guitar Hero music, now for the full band! Rock out to the most fun tracks from Guitar Hero, Guitar Hero II, Guitar Hero: Rock the 80's, and Guitar Hero III: Legends of Rock, now for the full band. Using the controllers strum, drum, and belt out a collection of master tracks including Nirvana, Judas Priest, Slayer, Rage Against the Machine, Queen, and many more.

Titled Guitar Hero Greatest Hits in Europe and Australia.

Pride FC - Fighting Championships.name: Pride FC: Fighting Championships
Pride FC - Fighting Championships.summary: Pride FC: Fighting Championships is a game based on the Japanese mixed martial arts organization of the same name.

Shinkon Gattai Godannar!!.name: Shinkon Gattai Godannar!!
Shinkon Gattai Godannar!!.summary: 3D Fighting game based on the anime TV series.

Sidewinder Max.name: Sidewinder Max
Sidewinder Max.summary: Sidewinder Max is a aircraft simulation game, developed by Bit Town and published by Asmik Ace Entertainment, Inc, which was released in Japan in 2000. An European release, titled Iron Eagle MAX, was planned but eventually cancelled.

Simple 2000 Series Vol. 83 - The Konchuu.name: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 83: The Konchuu Saishuu
Simple 2000 Series Vol. 83 - The Konchuu.summary: The Konchuu Saishuu: Strap on the Birkenstocks, jostle into the hemp shorts, and wander into the wilderness in search of bugs. As the story goes, a whole mess of insects have escaped from a laboratory. Gone. The hapless scientist at the lab charges the player with the task of finding the same bugs that fit the lab's specimen needs. The setting of the game takes place during summer vacation and the player adopts the persona of a boy with a fascination for insects. A rascally blue-haired girl plays the part of a rival that is also collecting specimens for the lab and barging in on your action.

Tiger Woods PGA Tour 2001.name: Tiger Woods PGA Tour 2001
Tiger Woods PGA Tour 2001.summary:
Swing into action with the first-ever PS2 golf game from Electronic Arts in Tiger Woods PGA Tour 2001. In all, six pro golfers take to the green on three real-life courses including SpyGlass Hill, Pebble Beach, and Poppy Hills as they swing and putt their way through exact replicas of all 18 holes.
The varied modes of play are now supported by two new entries, Challenge and Play-Now, in addition to such returning staples as Match, Skins, and Stroke.

Turbo Trucks.name: Turbo Trucks
Turbo Trucks.summary:
Turbo Trucks is an aggressive, no-holds-barred race to the finish line featuring a line up of some seriously mean vehicles.

Set across winding woodland courses and remote desert canyons, you get to choose from a selection of gorgeous trucks and take on opponents in successive races to earn coveted trophies in the tournaments, or hone your driving skills in the quick races and time trials. Win the tournaments to gain access to more courses and trucks!

Ram, smash and spin your opponents off the track while perfecting your racing line to gain the upper hand. Anything goes!

World Fantasista.name: World Fantasista
World Fantasista.summary: World Fantasista features life-like animation and real professional players from different countries, including Hiroshi Nanami, Patrick Mboma and Jose Luis Chilavert. In addition, there are 36 real Japanese players, world soccer teams from 35 countries, and the ability to create your own team.

Yoshitsune-ki.name: Yoshitsune-ki
Yoshitsune-ki.summary: Yoshitsune-ki is a historical action game released by Banpresto on December 1, 2005 for the PS2 and was Developed by Dream Factory . The game is known for having Popular Manga artist Takeshi Obata in charge of character design. The game takes place in the late Heian period to the early Kamakura period when Minamoto no Yoshitsune was active . While controlling the main character Yoshitsune, he fights monsters and the Heike with his companions, and aims to destroy the Heike by making full use of various swordsmanship in places such as Heiankyo, Hiraizumi , and Dannoura .
